longBio:
Daniel Bowden is a board member with a background in finance and community fundraising for youth services. He has supported housing and rangatahi-focused charities across Tāmaki Makaurau and brings a practical lens to budgeting and governance decisions.

Daniel is passionate about making sure resources reach the front line and that every dollar goes further for young people experiencing homelessness.
